description: Enable death link?
Send a death whenever you lose, reset, or leave any race or minigame,
or if your game crashes.
If you receive a death during a race or minigame, restart that race or
minigame immediately.
Defines the game completion prior to the start of the Archipelago run.
- NEW GAME: Start a new game and play through normally.
- NEW GAME WITH CHEATS: Start a new game. Allows using cheats to skip
around.
- FINISHED SAVE: Start with a save file that has all races unlocked.
Number of keys per boss race, except on Xalax, generated in the
multiworld.
Percentage of generated keys that are needed to partake in a boss
race.
Rounds down, with a minimum of 1, except that truncated decimals round
up (for example, 33% of 6 keys is 2).
Number of keys to The Grand Finale generated in the multiworld.
Percentage of generated keys that are needed to partake in The Grand
Finale.
Rounds down, with a minimum of 1, except that truncated decimals round
up (for example, 33% of 6 keys is 2).
How many checks is each boss race worth?
The Grand Finale is not worth any checks, as finishing that race is
simply The Goal. In a future version of this AP with customizable goal
support, The Grand Finale will be adjustable here.

filler_weight_item_embargo.display_name: Filler items: Weight of Item embargo
description: Relative weight for generating Item embargo as filler.
You may not use items for the duration of a race.
Relative weight for generating Freeze as filler.
You must hold the brakes for 15 seconds at the start of a race.

filler_weight_destroy_your_car.display_name: Filler items: Weight of Destroy your car
description: Relative weight for generating Destroy your car as filler.
You must destroy your car at some point during a race.

filler_weight_no_pitstops.display_name: Filler items: Weight of No pitstops
description: Relative weight for generating No pitstops as filler.
You must not use the pits at any point during a race.

filler_weight_no_shortcuts.display_name: Filler items: Weight of No shortcuts
description: Relative weight for generating No shortcuts as filler.
You must not take any shortcuts during a race.

filler_weight_drive_in_reverse.display_name: Filler items: Weight of Drive in reverse
description: Relative weight for generating Drive in reverse as filler.
You must drive in reverse into lap 2 and maintain it for 30 seconds
during a race.

filler_weight_top_down_camera.display_name: Filler items: Weight of Top-down camera
description: Relative weight for generating Top-down camera as filler.

filler_weight_speed_boost.display_name: Filler items: Weight of Speed boost
description: Relative weight for generating Speed boost as filler.

filler_weight_quit_adventure.display_name: Filler items: Weight of Quit adventure
description: Relative weight for generating Quit adventure as filler.
You must immediately quit to main menu without saving.

description: Relative weight for generating Cheese Wedge Bricks as filler.

Enable NPC checks?
Adds a check for every NPC in the game. This check is performed when
you see the named character speak in any situation.
